claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM hydroxyfasudil most plausibly inhibits PKA (PRKACA) in addition to ROCK1, producing weak anti-proliferative/cytostatic effects in a subset of cancer cell lines rather than broad cytotoxic killing.
